description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_SafeEmbed, which extends HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform and customizes attribute transformations for 'safe embed' elements, specifically setting security-related attributes for embedded Flash content.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_SafeEmbed
classes.description: A class that extends HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform to ensure safe embedding of Flash objects by setting attributes such as allowscriptaccess, allownetworking, and type.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Modifies the attributes for an embed tag to enforce security restrictions and specify the Flash type.
